Write a Plain-Language Run Summary

Source: R/lib_manifest.R
wrsmrytxt.Rd

Writes SUMMARY.txt into an output folder: a plain-text page a person can read without any software, giving the project, author, time, operating system and R version of the run, whether it ran on real or synthetic data, the paths it used, the tally of cross-check results, the files in the folder, and optional notes, contact and licence lines. It is the human-readable companion of wrmnfjs().

Usage

wrsmrytxt(man, outdir, paths, whatwasdone = NULL, contact = NULL, lic = NULL)

Arguments

man

A manifest as returned by mkmnf(); its meta supplies the header and its results the counts.

outdir

Character scalar, an existing folder to write SUMMARY.txt into and to list the files of.

paths

A named list (or named character vector) of paths to report, one line each, labelled by the capitalised name. Names such as capsule, input, results, analysis_script and provenance are typical. list() reports none.

whatwasdone

Optional character vector, one line each, describing what the run did. Default NULL (no section).

contact

Optional character scalar appended as a Contact: line. Default NULL.

lic

Optional character scalar appended as a Licence: line. Default NULL.

Value

The path to the written SUMMARY.txt (character scalar), invisibly.

Details

Header fields come from manifest$meta: project (default "(unnamed)"), author ("(unknown)"), run_at (default the current time), os (default Sys.info()), r_version (default R.version.string) and synthetic. When meta$r_package_versions is present a section lists those versions. Result counts are tallied from the status of each entry of manifest$results (PASS, DIFFER, WARN, INFO).

The file list is list.files(outdir) at the time of the call, sorted, so write the summary last. The paths are printed as given (they are not made absolute). An existing SUMMARY.txt is overwritten.

Errors when man is not a list, and (from base R) when outdir does not exist or cannot be written.

See also

mkmnf(), recrd(), wrmnfjs().

Examples

man <- mkmnf(list(project = "demo", author = "A. Author"),
  env = FALSE
)
man <- recrd(man, "rowcount", obs = 20, expd = 20)
#>   rowcount                                     observed = 20.0000      expected = 20.0000      [INFO]
out <- file.path(tempdir(), "demo-run")
dir.create(out, showWarnings = FALSE)
s <- wrsmrytxt(man, out, paths = list(results = out))
readLines(s)[7:8]
#> [1] "Project:   demo"      "Author:    A. Author"

# with notes, contact and licence lines
s <- wrsmrytxt(man, out, paths = list(results = out),
  whatwasdone = c("- read the extract", "- recomputed table 2"),
  contact = "analyst at example.org", lic = "CC BY 4.0")
tail(readLines(s), 6)
#> [1] "----------------------------------------------------------"
#> [2] "- read the extract"                                        
#> [3] "- recomputed table 2"                                      
#> [4] ""                                                          
#> [5] "Contact: analyst at example.org"                           
#> [6] "Licence: CC BY 4.0"                                        

# the manifest has to be a list
try(wrsmrytxt("demo", out, paths = list()))
#> Error : wrsmrytxt: `man` must be a manifest from mkmnf()
